info.title: Codehood API
info.description: REST API for the Codehood CLI and grading bots. Authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, except where noted — see src/urls/README.md.

servers.description: Same origin as the web app

BearerAuth.description: An API key for the CLI or a grading bot. Issued by POST /api/auth/login, or created on /profile.

token.description: The raw API key. Shown once; it can't be recovered later.

delete.summary: Delete a single Api Key by primary key.

put.summary: Upsert a single Calendar Event. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single Calendar Event by primary key.

put.summary: Upsert a single Course. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single Course by primary key.

put.summary: Upsert a single Discipline. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single Discipline by primary key.

put.summary: Upsert a single Edition. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single Edition by primary key.

put.summary: Upsert a single Exam. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single Exam by primary key.
Delete a single Invite by primary key.

put.summary: Upsert a single Resource. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single Resource by primary key.

put.summary: Upsert a single Question. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single Question by primary key.

put.summary: Upsert a single Response. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single Response by primary key.
Delete a single Submission by primary key.

put.summary: Upsert a single Feedback. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single Feedback by primary key.

post.description: Resolves the answer slot for the question — creating it when the student has not answered before — and appends one attempt to it. Returns the slot with every attempt it now holds.

put.summary: Upsert a single TimeSlot. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single TimeSlot by primary key.

post.description: Requires the current password. Every session the user holds is revoked, so a browser client has to log in again; API keys are left alone.

put.summary: Upsert a single User. Creates if it does not exist, update otherwise.

delete.summary: Delete a single User by primary key.

post.description: Logs out the current user by invalidating their session.

401.description: The login or password is incorrect.

get.description: Confirms the server can reach the database, not just that the process answers HTTP. Unauthenticated — uptime monitors and orchestration probes hitting this usually don't hold an API key.

503.description: The server is up but cannot reach the database.
